description: This file implements functions for parsing and validating Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs) in the context of X.509 certificates, including parsing CRL structures, handling distribution points, and checking revocation status against a certificate chain.

classes.name: ParsedCrlTbsCertList
classes.description: Structure representing the parsed TBSCertList part of a CRL, including version, signature algorithm, issuer, update times, extensions, and revoked certificates.

methods.name: ParseCrlCertificateList
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded CRL to extract the TBSCertList, signature algorithm, and signature value.

methods.name: ParseCrlTbsCertList
methods.description: Parses the TBSCertList DER structure to extract version, signature, issuer, update times, extensions, and revoked certificates.

methods.name: CheckCRL
methods.description: Validates a CRL against a certificate chain and distribution point, checking signatures, issuer, dates, and revocation status.
